Sect Library · priced credit
▾
Sect Library · priced credit

The Library elder keeps dated paper. Credit never exceeds a disciple's whole value. The first exchange is zero down at 36 percent a year, simple interest, repaid in flat yearly installments over 10 years.

Contribution points and the mission

CP in hand: 0. Missions done: 0. Rent is 30 CP a month (SOURCE, recorded only, not charged here).

Sect mission: shelve scrolls in the Library: 8 game hours, pays 5 CP less 1 CP for lamp oil, 1 a day. Prototype rates (AUTHORED, see the list at the foot). Not started.

Start the mission
Ask the Library for
Divine Firmament Sword Control True Formula: 1,000 CP (SOURCE, c0006 p32) Ask for it
Killing Life Curse: 300 CP (SOURCE, c0011 p46) Ask for it
Coiling Dragon method: 1,500 CP (SOURCE, c0027 p1) Ask for it
Ask the clerk how credit is weighed
Ledger

You owe the Library nothing.

Repay

Nothing to repay.

Held

Nothing issued yet.

If this life ends

death · Body and wealth: drops, this life. Nothing but memory and the chosen base cheat crosses without a carrier (AD11).

rebirth · Memories: carries, any life. Knowledge of people, routes and lines stays.

rebirth · Chosen base cheat: carries, any life. Authored proposal: it grows with the life and does not reset.

rebirth · Open obligations: drops, this life. A restart returns to intake with the first-exchange loan unused (SHOWN BASIS in the loop, c0015 p6, p9-15, p86); no recovery by the sect is shown. A restart that is not an intake reset is not shown, so this stays a dial.

No debt to carry.

Where the numbers come from

ratePerYear = 0.36: SOURCE. The first-exchange loan is zero down at 36 percent a year over ten years, simple interest on the original principal, repaid as a flat yearly installment: 1,000 CP owes 460 a year (100 principal plus 360 interest), 4,600 in all. (c0006 p33-36 (460 a year, 4,600 in all))

termYears = 10: SOURCE. Ten years to repay the first-exchange loan. (c0006 p33-36)

bodyValue = 1200: AUTHORED. A disciple's recorded total value in CP. The rule that credit never exceeds it is stated; the figure is authored so the 1,000 CP formula passes and a 1,500 CP method is refused. (rule (credit never exceeds total value) SOURCE c0009 p65-66; figure and formula AUTHORED)

secondHalfPrice = 600: AUTHORED. The first half of a method is issued free of charge; the second half is bought. The split is sourced, the price is not stated and is NOT canon. (split c0004 p11, c0006 p12-13; price open)

yearDays = 360: AUTHORED. The source shows a year as twelve monthly cycles (rent 30 CP a month, 360 a year) and gives no day count. Authored: 30-day months, 360-day year, which also matches the engine calendar. (c0008 p63-65 (SHOWN arithmetic); days per month authored)

restart = drops: SHOWN BASIS, dial kept. Whether an open loan crosses a restart. In the loop as shown, the restart returns to intake with the first-exchange loan unused again and no recovery by the sect (SHOWN). Only drops is built: the heir route copies a fixed key list that does not include this slice, so a debt that crosses a restart is not offered in this slice. A non-loop restart is not shown; the sect's price rule (credit never exceeds total value) is a principle, not an observed recovery. (loop: c0015 p6, p9-15, p86 (SHOWN); non-loop restart not shown; c0009 p66 (STATED))

rent = 30: SOURCE. Rent is 30 CP a month (recorded only, not charged in this slice, so the prototype task rates below are not tuned against it). (c0003 p25)

taskPay = 5: AUTHORED. Prototype pay for one Library shelving mission. Source: missions pay mostly single digits of CP (c0003 p33, STATED); the exact figure is authored. At one mission a day (30-day month) it is about 120 CP a month, enough to meet the 460 CP yearly installment in about four months of missions, so a borrower can repay without grinding. (single digits c0003 p33 (STATED); 5 AUTHORED)

taskCost = 1: AUTHORED. Prototype cost of one mission: lamp oil and wax, deducted from the pay when the shift ends (so a disciple with 0 CP can still start), on top of the time. (AUTHORED)

taskMinutes = 480: AUTHORED. Prototype length of one mission: eight game hours of normal game time. It completes through ordinary game ticks; other play continues, but the mission cannot be started again until it ends. (AUTHORED)

taskPerDay = 1: AUTHORED. Prototype limit: one mission per game day, so repaying takes calendar time and the interest keeps running. (AUTHORED)

yearDays = 360: AUTHORED. The source shows a year as twelve monthly cycles (rent 30 CP a month, 360 a year) and gives no day count. Authored: 30-day months, 360-day year, which also matches the engine calendar. (c0008 p63-65 (SHOWN arithmetic); days per month authored)

restart = drops: SHOWN BASIS, dial kept. Whether an open loan crosses a restart. In the loop as shown, the restart returns to intake with the first-exchange loan unused again and no recovery by the sect (SHOWN). Only drops is built: the heir route copies a fixed key list that does not include this slice, so a debt that crosses a restart is not offered in this slice. A non-loop restart is not shown; the sect's price rule (credit never exceeds total value) is a principle, not an observed recovery. (loop: c0015 p6, p9-15, p86 (SHOWN); non-loop restart not shown; c0009 p66 (STATED))

rent = 30: SOURCE. Rent is 30 CP a month (recorded only, not charged in this slice, so the prototype task rates below are not tuned against it). (c0003 p25)

taskPay = 5: AUTHORED. Prototype pay for one Library shelving mission. Source: missions pay mostly single digits of CP (c0003 p33, STATED); the exact figure is authored. At one mission a day (30-day month) it is about 120 CP a month, enough to meet the 460 CP yearly installment in about four months of missions, so a borrower can repay without grinding. (single digits c0003 p33 (STATED); 5 AUTHORED)

taskCost = 1: AUTHORED. Prototype cost of one mission: lamp oil and wax, deducted from the pay when the shift ends (so a disciple with 0 CP can still start), on top of the time. (AUTHORED)

taskMinutes = 480: AUTHORED. Prototype length of one mission: eight game hours of normal game time. It completes through ordinary game ticks; other play continues, but the mission cannot be started again until it ends. (AUTHORED)

taskPerDay = 1: AUTHORED. Prototype limit: one mission per game day, so repaying takes calendar time and the interest keeps running. (AUTHORED)
